_comment: Published per WP-SCP-022 020H.1 (closes 020H part 3 (xi) freshness-warning forward-looking flag). The reusable workflow's freshness-warning step compares this manifest at SCP main HEAD against the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin (in .scp-runtime/version-manifest.json) and emits ::warning:: when the wrapper is more than `freshness_warning_threshold_minor` minor versions behind. The threshold is read from the PINNED manifest, not from main HEAD (closes 020H.1 R1 SAFE-MIN-006). Bump `version` + `minor` + `released_at` together on every release. See policies/VERSIONING.md for the semver contract. v1.5.0 introduces WP-SCP-028 Phase 1 (D-058 first auth domain) — three new domain rules: SCP-R-009 (auth-canonical-version-pin), SCP-R-010 (auth-canonical-import-fence; two-tier), SCP-R-011 (auth-contract-claim-shape); all warn-baseline. Additive-rule MINOR. The rules ship loaded but vacuous-pass in production until a companion workflow PR materialises input.canonical_sdk_versions + input.auth_contract (cosign-verified via the .sig.bundle anchor) + input.adopter_* into the evaluation envelope and adds them to WARN_BASELINE_RULES (the SCP-R-006/R-030 safe-failure precedent). D-059 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome. (v1.4.0 was WP-SCP-030 Phase B.1 / SCP-R-030.) v1.5.1 is a PATCH bugfix: the workflow's manifest target-prep step emitted SCP-E002 and hard-failed the required gate when an adopter PR DELETED a manifest (package.json / pyproject.toml / go.mod) — the adopter-mode `git diff --name-only` enumeration includes deletions, and a removed manifest has no surface to evaluate or attest. The fix skips deleted manifests; the target-prep logic was extracted into lib/policy_check_invocation.sh (an internal surface per VERSIONING.md §Scope) as scp_policy_check_prepare_manifest_targets so it is directly unit-tested (tests/workflow/test_prepare_manifest_targets.py, run by the workflow-selftest prepare-manifest-targets-unit job). No input/schema/rule-ID surface changed. v1.6.0 is WP-SCP-028 Phase 2 (the companion materialisation / FIRING step for the D-058 auth domain): an additive Option-A `opa eval` repo-level pass in policy-check.yml materialises input.canonical_sdk_versions + input.auth_contract (fetched from the PUBLIC estate-canonicals surface per D-061 and cosign-verified against CT's contract-manifest-publish.yml keyless identity — Decision A, BOTH canonicals signed; the *_verified flags derive ONLY from the workflow's own cosign exit, never adopter content) + input.adopter_* (workflow-extracted), then merges SCP-R-009/010/011 findings into policy-findings.json and adds those three rules to BOTH WARN_BASELINE_RULES sites (the coupling guard). The three auth rules now FIRE warn-baseline in production (were dormant/vacuous at v1.5.0). The conftest per-file pass (SCP-R-001..008) is untouched. Additive minor (firing previously-dormant rules; no rule-ID/schema surface change). End-to-end fixtures: tests/workflow/fixture-scp-r-028-{pass,import-fence,trust-boundary}. D-059 reserved for the post-4-week-observation deny-promotion outcome.
_schema_note: No JSON Schema $schema URL — version-manifest.json is a load-bearing public surface (every adopter wrapper at 020H.1+ reads this at workflow run time) but the shape is small and stable; fields are documented in policies/VERSIONING.md and ADOPT-001 §12.7.11. If the surface grows, file a schema at schemas/version-manifest.schema.json (closes 020H.1 R1 COR-MANIFEST-002).
